_note: D1 (2026-10-31), see mesen2-results/D1_20261031.md. (1) CameraShakeActor queues sound #15 on every tick (61 times), not once: shipped comment wrong. (2) The NMI sound drain moves the whole word $06F8/$06F9 to APUIO2/APUIO3, not only sfxQueueCh1 to APUIO2: shipped step 13 and two comments incomplete. (3) 'the scene's current music index' for $06F2 holds only right after a scene load (static: the writers of $06F2 are SpcMusicLoadCmd scene_script.asm:1298, pyCD_jackal.asm:118 and item_use_system.asm:921; the 71 StartMusic/FadeThenStartMusic sites never write it). Dry-run only: npm run merge -- plans/extracted-audit/mesen2-results/specs/D1_notes.json --dry-run. Comments go through expectOld because extracted/ carries no line-tracking tags; the apply pass may switch to expect after extract:lt. 'find' must occur exactly once in the stored note.
